title: Zesty Silky French Prune Confit
description: A garlicky and silky French dish featuring prunes, perfect for a date night, and suitable for flexitarian diets. This recipe is a delicious and flavorful way to enjoy prunes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the prunes, thyme, and bay leaves, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves and stir in the butter until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the prune confit warm, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
